name: PostFinish
_intent: The awakening's finisher: from the flurry, a big wind-up (weight back, right fist chambered at the hip, left hand out as a sight), then one full-body right straight that drives 0.6 studs THROUGH the post's face (the post bursts on the Hit), rear heel up, held, then settle into TrainPost's first frame.
_reference: karate/anime finishing straight punch through a target; Hit at frame 15 (0.5000 s)

keyframes._note: WIND-UP: weight back, right fist at the hip, left hand out as the sight
WIND-UP: weight back, right fist at the hip, left hand out as the sight
HIT: the right straight drives 0.6 through the face, rear heel up

_contact.what: the striking fist's frontmost knuckle corner on the plane; its end face as flat as the arm allows
